title: Peer status
description: What one node publishes for its peer (node mesh, ADR-018): signed by the node's own key. The peer polls it; a bad signature, an old issued_at or a counter that did not advance counts as silence. It carries no secrets and no camera or sensor data.

node.description: The publishing node, cell:<name>. It is also the signer.

counter.description: Strictly increasing per node (it survives restarts); a document whose counter did not advance is a replay.

snapshot_age_s.description: Age of the Field Station snapshot, when the node has one.
